form.newSubtitle: Register a supplier. It starts as prospective until an evaluation approves it.
form.readOnly: You can view this supplier but not change it.

form.changeReasonHint: Saved in the revision history so others can see why the record changed.

statusDialog.title: Change supplier status
statusDialog.hint: Approval normally comes from a decided evaluation. Change the status by hand when something happens between evaluations, for example a suspension after a serious incident.
statusDialog.approvalOnly: Only people with approval rights can move a supplier into or out of approved, conditional, suspended or rejected.
statusDialog.approvalNote: This change counts as an approval decision and is recorded as yours.
